title: Not actual blackout drapes. Midweight material n a nice grey color
text:
Not actual blackout drapes. Midweight material n a nice grey color. First off, these are not blackout drapes by any stretch of the imagination and I'm really tired of companies trying to pretend their product is better than it actually is. These drapes do reduce sunlight and exterior light that comes into the room, but they do not blackout all the light. See my photo.

The drapes themselves are a nice mid-weight velvet like material that is soft and thicker than a regular curtain. These do help block a little winter air due to the thickness and that's certainly good. The color is a nice grey that works with most color palettes.
